title: The Garden of the Ninefold Court
author: Lena Almeida
blurb: Ines Okonkwo, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
